posts.author: KiZai
posts.title: The Serious RP Job System
posts.edited: Last Edit: June 19, 2009, 10:21:58 PM by KiZai
posts.html:
Hey all,

Before I begin, the Serious RP server is currently only in the concept stage. The final class system may look nothing like this, including none of the below classes; it is merely my brain-splatter of ideas on which for you to comment.

I am thinking that the Serious RP server should follow a similar class structure to HL2 roleplay, with most classes only attainable through promotion from an admin. Certain classes will receive higher wages and will be entitled to greater royalties.

You will no longer be able to hammer F1 and slip into any job as you please. Once you create a character, they may only have one job; to reach the higher ranked classes, you must work your way up the employment ladder, starting at the bottom. The better you perform at your current job, the more likely you are to attain a new, higher ranked class if desired.

Here is my proposed class structure, any feedback is great to change it for the better:


Base classes: The lowest of the low within this society. They have no royalties; the unemployed citizen class is the only class legally entitled to benefits.

1) Unemployed Citizen: This is your standard class; everyone's character will initially start out as an ordinary citizen. You are unemployed, and you are seeking work. You rely on benefits to survive, which are handed out by the benefit administration team (more on that later). You have no wage, you get everything you have through benefits.

2) Outcast: This class is reserved for those who are not accepted in society, possibly through anti official behaviour or through criminal activities. This class must not set foot within the main city. They are greatful that they still have their lives, but will likely feel resent towards the rest of society for leading a 'good' life. They are not entitled to benefits and receive no wages of any kind; it is a battle to survive.


Working class: Experience no more privelages than an unemployed citizen.

1) Litter Picker: You roam the streets, and you clean it up. Its not a glamorous job, but its something. You will get a small wage, which is greater than benefits, but its barely anything. You are not entitled to benefit as you are no longer employed, attempting to do so is benefit fraud, and will result in a jail sentance.

2) Industrial Worker: Works in manual labour, usually a factory. Receives a small wage, but slightly more than a litter picker.


Middle class: Are entitled with entry to more areas than others, and are permitted to speak in public places.

1) Supplier: You manage a small scale business based on buying and selling a variety of miscellaneous goods, such as batteries, flashlights, books (if implemented) etc. receives a medium/low wage, as most money should be made from merchanting

2) Pharmacist: Supplies doctors with medical goods. Receives a medium wage. Can not supply to civilians without breaking the law, they must supply to either a medic or a doctor.

3) Medic: A medic who must buy medical supplies from a pharmacist, and roams the town in search of people to help. They are under the command of the doctors, and will go where instructed when instructed. This earns a medium wage, and they may charge extra if desired.

4) Chef: Charged with supplying food the the masses. Can produce a variety of products to satisfy hunger and, if implemented, thirst. They will receive a medium/low wage.


Upper class: Far superiour that the Middle and working class, they have access to everywhere that is not a police zone, and experience the highest wages.

1) Businessman: Can buy and sell a large variety of goods, including several rare items for high prices: request devices, pockets/backpacks, car insurance (use the document in yoru inventory to apply it to your car) etc. They can also buy all goods that a supplier can buy and receive a medium/high wage.

2) Doctor: Sets up a clinic and attends to injured civilians/officials. Can not buy medical supplies of their own, and must charge civilians, whilst medical care is to be given to officials free of charge. Receives a high wage.

3) Firearms Dealer: Can purchase pistols and pistol ammo only, and can supply to officials only (legally). Receive a medium/high wage.

4) City Management Official: The only class which receive the applications from citizens (in person) and pass judgement as to whether they get their desired job. This is an admin only class. They receive a very high wage and can promote Unemployed Citizens to working, middle, or upper class. They can also promote civilians into Comunity Support Officers or secretaries.


Law enforcement department (The Officials): Charged with keeping order in the city, using whatever means necessary.

1) Community Support Officer: The starting block for any law enforcement career. You have no powers, but receive a request device upon promotion and are charged with roaming the city, and informing higher ranking officials of any law-breaking. They receive a low/medium wage.

2) Secretary: Handle complaints from citizens in person. Have direct contact with the City Mayor (if there is a mayor) and are charged with prioritising complaints. It is usually a secretary who will respond to a request from a civilian. Receive a medium wage.

3) Benefit Administrator: Hands out benefits at a set time each day at a set location. This is the only class that can hand out benefits, and benefits are only given to the unemployed. They have no legal power, but can contact the police force with their request device.

4) Official Wares Dealer: This is an admin only class, who can order any weapon and any kind of ammo, along with other illegal goods such as breachers, or the more subtle lockpicks. They can only supply to Officials, and will not break this rule. Receive a high wage, but all officials must pay for these weapons unless stated otherwise.

5) Police Recruit: Can carry a small firearm and are usually tasked with handling smaller tasks such as robberies. Can perform arrests, search civilians, and carry a small firearm (pistol). Apply on the forum to attain this job (must have a character who is a secretary/community support officer).

6) Police Officer: Always with a partner, and charged with keeping order in the town. Can perform arrests, search civilians, and can legally carry a small firearm (pistol) or an SMG. Receive a medium/high wage. Takes orders from a Commander or Mayor. Attainable by proving your self as a Recruit, and being promoted by an admin. Police Officers may also carry a taser.

7) Police Commander: Organise the Police force and maintain contact with the mayor (if present). Can broadcast and initiate lockdowns. Commanders can also legally carry a firearm of any shape or size. You will be promoted by an admin to this rank if you prove you are a good roleplayer as a Police Officer. This class can authorise/conduct executions, perform arrests, search civilians, and are charged with organising police operations (This includes operations which include Special Forces Officials).

8} Special Forces Official: Are used in times of raids or hostage situations to execute the operation swiftly and smoothly with minimum casualties. You will be promoted to this rank after proving yourself as a valued member of the police force; you must apply on the forums. Authorised to use breachers, flashbang grenades/stun grenades and either a rifle or a shotgun to serve justice. This class also comes equipped with a tranquiliser gun as standard.

9) Mayor: Admin only. Only one may be mayor at a time and are in charge with organising the police force/managing public relations. They must make public appearances and handle the criticisms of the civilians. The mayor can also promote civilians to any class. Receive the highest wage of all classes.


The absense of any rebel classes is intentional. If you wish to be a rebel, do so in character; this will also eliminate class descrimination as nobody will be able to immediately identify 'rebels'.

Here are a couple of example career progressions to think about (there will be no set paths, instead you will need progress in a way you see as ideal to reach your ideal class):

A Businessman: Unemployed Citizen->(Speak to a City Management Official)->Litter Picker->(Speak to a City Management Official)->Supplier->(Speak to a City Management Official)->Businessman

A Police Commander: Unemployed Citizen->(Speak to a City Management Official)->Community Support Officer->(Apply for Police on forums)->Police Recruit->(Prove you are good at police roleplay)->Police Officer->(Excel at police roleplay)->Police Commander

Well those are my ideas, please comment upon them with any additional classes, additional details, or classes which need not exist etc. All criticism appreciated.

-KiZai

posts.html:
Quote from: PRCheese on June 19, 2009, 10:21:45 PM
Sounds nice, but I don't like the Official Wares Dealer that much, and actually had a different idea for firearms in the Serious RP server:

All firearms and weapons are delivered via supply lines, in regular intervals.
A special Official Class, "Manager" let's call it, is ordered to handle the supply lines by going up to them, manufacturing the certain weapons and ammo (they need to pay for it of course, otherwise resources will run out and weapons will no longer be delivered) and sending the supply crate away.
Perhaps a once per 30 minutes regular interval, with the Mayor being able to rush one or cancel one (during lockdowns the supply lines are closed).
 Therefore, it is also the Manager's job to stop smugglers from stealing weapons. Weapon theft could handle like the Manager, or it could be a random weapon/ammo combination in there in case of Smugglers.

Plus, Mayor should have some exceptions, and not be admin-only. Only a select few from the community will be able to gain access to it.

The weapons system I propose allows us to easily control the amount of firearms in circulation (we don't want another DM-fest now do we?), stopping it when desired, rather than having a constant supply as you state. Weapons will not be created unless there is an appropriate ranking member online. It also adds need to find the dealer, rather than walking to a supply line. Supply lines also require extr map features - we don't want to be bound to just one map.

Guns will be incredibly rare on this server, with interesting roleplay required to obtain them -> bribing a firearms dealer for example, or knocking out and tying a police officer, before stripping him of his weapons/radio and leaving him to rot. If you have a gun, you will not make it public knowledge; if the officials catch wind of this you will be arrested, and your firearm taken if discovered. The system of containers Lexi is currently developing will also allow you to hide these items discreetly.

Quote from: Recon on June 19, 2009, 10:23:25 PM
Disagree that only Admins can be mayor. I think trusted members should be allowed to temporarily act as a mayor.

There will be no 'temporary' jobs. Once you create a character, it stays as the job you obtain, although you may have multiple characters.

As the mayor can also alter peoples classes it requires an admin behind it, although there are always exceptions.

This will not be like the Light RP server with mayors rolling into and out of power upon death, there will be a few long-standing mayors who will alternate their time in power - a mayor will not simply leave the position upon death, unless the character is permanently killed.

5 deaths = permakill, unless arranged otherwise. You will not want to die on this server. If a mayor is killed, that player's mayor character will become temporarily disabled - say for 24 hours without admin intervention - forcing them to use another character.

Things will be very different from Light RP.

-KiZai

posts.html:
Quote from: Alexander on June 20, 2009, 07:31:35 PM
Will there be some kind of court or other judging system?

Might be something that could be worked in.

The arrest system will be manual; this means no warrants or teleporting arrest baton. You will be escorted to jail (tied up) after commiting an offence, you may be dragged there unconscious if you resist (which would be a stupid thing to do). You will be in jail for as long as the highest ranking Official currently on the server sees fit.

Under some circumstances you may not even leave...

I can't see why a judgement system couldn't be implemented as a more formal way of administering a sentance.

posts.html:
I was thinking of something along the lines of expanding the Business man into its own group? So the big companies can manage things. Such as this

Please note that anything above Rookie has to earn a promotion. A rookie has to go through a job interview to work.

Companies

1) Rookie - Can do simple jobs in the company but has to observe the workers to learn what to do. Also has to get promoted to worker

2) Worker - Does what ever the CEO of COF commands them to do. Also can allow rookie's to observe them to learn

3) Security guard - Promotion only by the CEO and COF this man can obtain his job and include a fire alarm if approved by an admin

4) CEF - Only by CEO approval this is the Chief of staff of the company. His job is to make sure everyone is working and at there stations. He also manages the work schedule

5) Technician - Fixes problems that sprang up into the system. Also buys products for the company to use.

6) Chairman - He is like the Co-Owner of the company. He decides on financial situations with the CEO's approval

7) Finaly the CEO. He is the head of the business. The rich man that started it all. He keeps his money locked in a safe and pays wages to the workers. He also looks over all of the workers. Manages them, invites them, and fires them.

So hope you like my new class category I wanted to add. Now its 2:56 AM And I must sleep.
